description: This file defines the TestPubSubFactory class used for testing pub/sub functionalities within the org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.pubsub package. It manages subscriptions and topics, providing methods to retrieve subscribers and generate message prefixes.

classes.name: TestPubSubFactory
classes.description: A factory class for setting up pub/sub testing scenarios, providing subscriber management based on message topics.

methods.name: getSubscribers
methods.description: Retrieves the subscribers for a specific topic from distributed data.

methods.name: getSubscribers (private static)
methods.description: Retrieves subscribers for a collection of topics, used internally within the class.

methods.name: getSeeds
methods.description: Returns the collection of seed integers used for hashing.

methods.name: getPrefixes
methods.description: Generates a list of prefix strings from a given message string.
